title: Core: Shape tween interpolation
description: Implement shape tween interpolation between two keyframes in packages/core/src/model/timeline-query.ts. Flash 8 shape tweens interpolate between matching vertices of two ShapeDisplayObjects. Simple approach: linear interpolation of path vertices (same count), blending x/y coords at t=frameIndex/spanLength. If vertex counts differ, skip interpolation (show start frame). Tests: shape tween at t=0.5 returns midpoint coords, t=0 returns start, t=1 returns end.
